scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:discord: concurrently -n client,server,tunnel -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run tunnel -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.triage: concurrently -n "types:client,types:server,lint" -c cyan,green,yellow --kill-others-on-fail "npm run typecheck -w client" "npm run typecheck -w server" "npm run lint"
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
